Lemma
[Characterization of regular points] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0495, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0496, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0497 ↗ def:chow-iii-i30-i31-gradient-regularity ↗ lem:chow-iii-i30-i33-regular-open 1. appi:1.34,appi:1.35\group Critical point theory

For $x\ne p$, $x$ is regular iff there exist $V\in S_x^{n-1}$, $c>0$, and $\varepsilon >0$ such that \[ r(\exp _x(sV))-r(x)\ge cs\qquad (0\le s<\varepsilon ). \] Equivalently, every sufficiently short unit-speed path initially tangent to a suitable $V$ increases $r$ at a uniform positive rate.
